findings.problem: Layout consumes the mutable episode instead of its connected storyboard output, allowing a sibling branch's scenes into the wrong production branch. Quote preparation repeats this at line 634.
findings.reproduction: Connect two distinct script/storyboard branches and order their IDs so both storyboards execute before branch A's layout. A memory-only execution confirmed that layout A and its render contained storyboard B's scene IDs and text.
findings.correction: Build layout inputs from the uniquely resolved connected storyboard output. Apply the same rule during quote preparation.

findings.problem: Render-only resume resolves storyboard/layout prerequisites without adding their outputs to requiredReuse. renderCandidate then silently falls back to episode.scenes at line 657.
findings.reproduction: Finish a branched run whose saved episode contains branch B while branch A retains distinct storyboard/layout outputs. Resume only render A. The memory-only probe returned reusedOutputs=[] and rendered the current episode instead of the connected branch output.
findings.correction: Reuse the resolved scene-producing dependencies during render resume. When a connected producer lacks valid output, reject execution instead of substituting the current episode.

findings.problem: Each generation input fingerprints the entire target scene, including sibling slots. Applying one approved slot invalidates another independently approved slot in that scene.
findings.reproduction: Quote two generate nodes targeting different image slots in the same scene, then execute both. A memory-only adapter confirmed gen-a completed, gen-b failed with 'The approved node input changed', and render was skipped.
findings.correction: Validate against an expected candidate advanced only by previously approved results, or isolate target-slot inputs while preserving relevant shared-scene guards. Retain each node's original job identity.

findings.problem: Whole-workflow generation selection includes publish. The engine rejects publish alongside generation/render/review at server/workflows.mjs:262, preventing the full-pipeline UI from obtaining a quote.
findings.reproduction: Use the full-pipeline recipe, prepare its source stages, then request the whole-candidate quote. generationSelection includes publish on both initial and resumed paths. The authoritative full-pipeline test explicitly excludes publish at tests/production-generation-plan.test.mjs:539.
findings.correction: Exclude publish from preparation/generation execution selections and expose it separately after the required approvals.

findings.problem: Stage readiness requires every ancestor to have completed/succeeded/reused status. An approved review ancestor therefore blocks valid downstream execution.
findings.reproduction: Use render-1 → review-1 → render-2, finish and approve review-1, then select render-2. Evaluating the actual stageInfo function returned blocked with review-1 listed as missing. The sequential repeated-producer API scenario is supported by tests/production-workflow-graph.test.mjs:386.
findings.correction: Match readiness to the server's connected prerequisite and reusable-evidence semantics, including valid reviewed states, while preserving publish's explicit approval requirements.
